test.//inputs: Exclude *.e2e.ts so editing a resource-consuming suite never invalidates the default lane's cache — it never runs those files (its vitest `include` is `src/**/*.spec.ts`, see vite.config.ts). Mirrors the workspace targetDefaults.test inputs plus the negative pattern.

e2e.//: Resource-consuming lane: runs ONLY the `*.e2e.ts` suite extracted out of the default `test` target (real venv provisioning + `spawnSync` python probes, plus a `dist/` copy). Opt-in and deliberately NOT wired into any `test.dependsOn` nor into nx.json `targetDefaults`, so `nx affected -t test` / the pre-commit + pre-push hooks never reach it. `dependsOn: ["build"]` because the moved suite reads this package's OWN build (the published-layout checks read dist/python/, produced by this package's build). Its coverage dir is DISTINCT from the default lane's, and declares no dist-shaped output.
